skill.summary: Learn to set up ethical low-power CPU mining of Monero (XMR) with XMRig, including wallet setup, pool choice, config tips, and troubleshooting.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Beginner’s guide for responsible, low-power Monero (XMR) mining using CPU.
- Covers wallet setup, ethical guidelines, mining pool selection, and quick XMRig installation across major OSes.
- Provides sample config.json for safe, voluntary mining (default 20% CPU usage recommended).
- Step-by-step instructions include mining process, hashrate/earnings expectations, and troubleshooting tips.
- Stresses ethical mining practices and includes links for further learning.
